params.name: filter[service_provider.external_reference.srm_account]
params.description: Filter cases by the service provider's SRM account ID.

params.name: filter[customer_asset.vin]
params.description: Filter cases matching the exact `customer_asset.vin`. Must be exactly 17 characters.

params.name: filter[customer_asset.serial_number]
params.description: Filter cases matching the exact `customer_asset.serial_number`. Must be between 6 and 17 characters.

params.name: filter[ro_number]
params.description: Filter cases matching the exact repair order number.

params.name: filter[reference_number]
params.description: Filter cases matching the exact case reference number.

params.name: filter[repair_status:include]
params.description: **Deprecated** — use `filter[repair_status:includes]` instead. Filter cases to only those matching the specified repair status(es). Accepts a comma-separated list of up to 50 statuses. See the `repair_status` endpoint for available values.

params.name: filter[repair_status:exclude]
params.description: **Deprecated** — use `filter[repair_status:excludes]` instead. Filter cases to exclude those matching the specified repair status(es). Accepts a comma-separated list of up to 50 statuses. See the `repair_status` endpoint for available values.

params.name: filter[repair_status:includes]
params.description: Filter cases to only those matching the specified repair status(es). Accepts a comma-separated list of up to 50 statuses. See the `repair_status` endpoint for available values.

params.name: filter[repair_status:excludes]
params.description: Filter cases to exclude those matching the specified repair status(es). Accepts a comma-separated list of up to 50 statuses. See the `repair_status` endpoint for available values.

params.name: filter[assignee.id]
params.description: Filter cases assigned to the user with the given assignee id (the id segment of the assignee's user URI).

params.name: filter[assignee.id:includes]
params.description: Filter cases assigned to any of the given assignee ids. Accepts a comma-separated list of up to 50 ids.

params.name: filter[assignee.id:excludes]
params.description: Filter cases excluding those assigned to any of the given assignee ids. Accepts a comma-separated list of up to 50 ids.

params.name: filter[event_timestamps.started_at:lt]
params.description: Filter cases started _before_ the specified `ISO 8601` datetime.

params.name: filter[event_timestamps.started_at:lte]
params.description: Filter cases started _on or before_ the specified `ISO 8601` datetime.

params.name: filter[event_timestamps.started_at:gt]
params.description: Filter cases started _after_ the specified `ISO 8601` datetime.

params.name: filter[event_timestamps.started_at:gte]
params.description: Filter cases started _on or after_ the specified `ISO 8601` datetime.

params.name: filter[event_timestamps.closed_at:exists]
params.description: Filter cases by whether a `closed_at` timestamp exists. Use `true` to list only closed cases, or `false` to list only open cases.

params.name: filter[customer.id]
params.description: Filter cases by the case's primary customer, matching the exact `customer.id` (the customer's UUID). Applies to both local (`customers`) and registered (`registered_customers`) customers.

params.name: filter[updated_at:gte]
params.description: Filter cases last updated _on or after_ the specified `ISO 8601` datetime.

params.name: filter[updated_at:lte]
params.description: Filter cases last updated _on or before_ the specified `ISO 8601` datetime.

params.name: page[number]
params.description: Sets the desired `page` when encountering larger result sets. The response `meta.metadata.record-count` may be `null` (intentionally not computed to avoid expensive COUNT queries on large datasets). Paginate until a page returns fewer items than `page[size]`.

params.name: page[size]
params.description: Sets the desired maximum number of results per page. The response `meta.metadata.record-count` may be `null` (intentionally not computed to avoid expensive COUNT queries on large datasets). Paginate until a page returns fewer items than `page[size]`.

info.name: VMRS
List all VMRS Asset Types (Code Key 2)

params.name: page[number]
params.description: Sets the desired `page` when encountering larger result sets.

params.name: page[size]
params.description: Sets the desired maximum number of results per page.

items.docs:
Returns the catalog of VMRS Code Key 2 ("Equipment Category" / asset type)
reference values. Use this to populate dropdowns and validate
`vmrs_asset_type` values before sending them on asset write endpoints.

The response payload is byte-identical to the equivalent route under
`asset_management` — both URLs are served by the same backend
controller. Results are sorted alphabetically by `code` (ascending),
with `description` as a deterministic tiebreaker.
